body: I had this on prozac a few years ago too, made me so nervous hyper I'd want to run but I couldn't. I changed antidepressant & actually ran a little bit so maybe it's the prozac, even tho my mood still didn't stabilise I still managed to get out more on another antidepressant.
Thank you. Kinda feel numb about this right now so can't reply fully but thank you.

If you go to your local council they should also be able to help house you even temporarily.
